about: The Claude Code actions tree in the desktop app's Terminal tab. A 'prompt' item types its text into Claude Code's input (nothing is sent until you press Enter, so fill in the <...> parts first); a 'tab' item opens that tab (live, manager, site, insights, bot, terminal, git). Edit freely; Reload interface (Ctrl+Alt+R) picks up changes.

items.title: Read a channel into a transcript
items.description: Vaulty reads a Discord channel (and its threads) into discord_server/transcripts/: a .md to read and a .json for the stats.
items.prompt: /vaultulation-bot Read the Discord channel #<channel> with its threads into a transcript (ask.py read), from <date> to <date>.

items.title: Write a session report
items.description: GM notes first (never published), then the in-character version: an official GEC return report for expeditions, a witness or participant account for RP scenes.
items.prompt: Write a session report from discord_server/transcripts/<transcript>.md: the GM notes first, then the in-character published version.

items.title: Analyse the latest session (all steps)
items.description: Transcript → stats → moments and funniest bits, ready for your review in the dashboard.
items.prompt: /table-insights Analyse the latest session from #<channel>: read the transcript, run the stats, then do the moments and humor pass.

items.title: Stats for a transcript
items.description: Code only, no AI: spotlight shares, turns, bursts, quiet players and 'worth a look' flags (analyze.py).
items.prompt: /table-insights Run the stats for discord_server/transcripts/<transcript>.json as session <session-id>.

items.title: Moments & funniest bits
items.description: The AI reading pass: 1–3 moments per player and up to 10 humor candidates, quotes checked word for word (moments.py import).
items.prompt: /table-insights Do the moments and humor reading pass for session <session-id>.

items.title: Draft the funny-moments poll
items.description: Only confirmed humor candidates whose players agreed to be featured; drafts the poll, nothing is posted.
items.prompt: /table-insights Draft the funny-moments poll from session(s) <session-id>, and show me the preview.

items.title: Open the dashboard
items.description: Review moments, confirm or reject, record poll consent.

items.title: Write entries from a canon packet
items.description: Encyclopedia-style Archive entries with canon-safety checks, written to lore/entries/.
items.prompt: /nowhere-lore-writer Write Archive entries from this canon packet: <paste the packet or describe it>

items.title: Expand or fix existing entries
items.prompt: /nowhere-lore-writer Revise the Archive entry <entry> : <what to change>

items.title: Load lore drafts into the content manager
items.description: As drafts: you publish them from the content manager.
items.prompt: /nowhere-lore-writer Load the new lore entries into the content manager as drafts.

items.title: Add or change a bot command
Preview a post before it goes out
items.description: Preview only; posting needs your approval in the bot.
items.prompt: /vaultulation-bot Preview <the post or embed> for #<channel>. Don't post it.

items.title: Summarise what's changed
items.description: Uncommitted changes grouped by area, with suggested commit messages.
items.prompt: Summarise the uncommitted changes in this repository, grouped by area, and suggest how to split them into commits.
